newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to hold no JGB auctions next week - traders.
newsitem.headline: Japan to hold no JGB auctions next week - traders.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) plans no bond auctions next week, traders said on Friday.

MOF's next auction is expected to be for six-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) and traders said it is likely to be held in the week starting on May 6, after the "Golden Week" holiday ends on May 5.
The Tokyo financial markets are closed on April 29 and May 5 for national holidays. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-8570
